plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that he too was told about a craft said to be heading slowly toward Earth. He said it in 2026 while talking with a filmmaker named Jeremy Corbell, whose sources were telling the same story. If true, it would mean people inside the government expect a visit.
